elastic/kibana#910101.title: [Detection Engine] Run ES|QL rules when some source indices are missing
elastic/kibana#910101.body:
## Summary
Today an ES|QL rule fails the whole execution when one index in its `FROM` clause does not exist. Rules that query several sources stop alerting when one source is removed.

The rule executor should run the query on the indices that exist, record a warning in the execution log that names the missing indices, and set the rule status to `Partial failure` so the rule details page shows it.

## Acceptance criteria
- A rule whose `FROM` clause includes a missing index still runs on the existing indices and creates alerts.
- The execution log has a warning listing the missing indices.
- The rule details page shows `Partial failure` with the warning text.
- When every index in `FROM` is missing, the execution fails as today.
